# AAA Awning Co., Inc.

> Custom fabric and metal awning, canopy, and shade-structure fabrication
> and installation across Texas. Family-run since 1984, headquartered in
> Houston. Sunbrella Preferred Partner. All design, fabrication, and
> installation handled in-house by AAA employees — no subcontractors.
> Service area covers Houston metro and Texas Gulf Coast (including
> Galveston and Corpus Christi), Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex, Austin
> metro, and San Antonio metro. Free on-site estimates. Residential and
> commercial projects of any size.

## Company facts

- Legal name: AAA Awning Co., Inc.
- Common name: AAA Awning
- Industry: Awning, canopy, and shade-structure manufacturing & installation
- Founded: 1984
- Years in business: 40+
- Ownership: Family-run, privately held
- Headquarters: 8810 Madie Drive, Houston, TX 77022-2617
- Dallas / Richardson satellite office: 2511 Prairie Creek Dr. West,
  Richardson, TX 75080 (by appointment only)
- Austin coordination: phone-only, (512) 459-1540 (crews dispatch from
  Houston)
- Main phone: (713) 694-3930
- Dallas phone: (214) 553-0733
- Austin phone: (512) 459-1540
- Email: admin@aaaawning.net
- Website: https://aaaawning.net
- Hours: Monday – Friday, 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM Central Time
- Sunbrella Preferred Partner — authorized awning fabric distributor
- All installations performed by AAA employees; no subcontractors
- Design, drawings, fabrication, and installation handled in-house

## Pricing & sales process

- Free on-site / in-home estimates with no obligation
- Estimator visits the property, measures, takes site photos, and
  produces a written quote with material specs and shop drawings
- Typical lead time: ~3 to 6 weeks from signed quote to install,
  depending on project size and material availability
- Payment terms: deposit on order, balance on installation
- Pricing: residential awnings start in the low thousands; commercial
  and estate projects scale with size, materials, and engineering
- We do not publish fixed prices — every project is a custom build

## Services

### Fabric awnings
Custom canvas and Sunbrella awnings for storefronts, restaurants,
patios, windows, entryways, and hospitality. In-house graphics
department prints logos and signage directly onto awning fabric.
Default fabric is Sunbrella acrylic canvas (10-year fabric warranty);
also vinyl-coated polyester for heavy-duty / food-service applications;
shade cloth for pool decks and playgrounds.

### Metal awnings
Standing-seam, R-panel, and corrugated metal awning systems with
Kynar 500 painted finishes. Hail-resistant in North Texas; coastal-grade
hardware for Gulf Coast applications.

### Extruded aluminum awnings, walkway covers, and canopies
Heavy-gauge extruded aluminum systems for commercial walkway covers,
school and institutional shade, and high-wear applications.

### Retractable awnings
Manual and motorized retractable awning systems. Smart-home integration
for premium residential.

### Canopies
Commercial entry canopies, drive-thru canopies, valet canopies,
hospitality and restaurant patio canopies.

### Carports
Steel and aluminum carports — residential and small commercial.

### Gazebos and cabanas
Pool cabanas, residential gazebos, and outdoor-kitchen pavilions
matched to existing property architecture.

### Shade structures
Tensioned shade-sail and structural shade installations for parks,
schools, daycares, commercial properties, and HOAs.

### Shade sails
Tensioned fabric shade sails — residential and commercial.

### Patio curtains
Outdoor curtains in canvas, vinyl, and mesh — wind, sun, bug, and
privacy control.

### Exterior motorized screens
Motorized retractable screens for outdoor living, pool cabanas, and
covered porches.

### Custom services
- Custom awning shapes (dome, shed, waterfall, quarter-barrel,
  concave, convex, gable, mansard, custom)
- Hand-painted and embroidered fabric signage
- Hurricane-rated coastal-grade installations with stamped engineering
- Post-storm damage assessment and repair
- Re-covering existing awning frames with new fabric
- Architectural coordination with exterior designers and landscape
  architects (estate residential)
- HOA-compatible designs with drawings for architectural review

## Materials we use

- Sunbrella acrylic canvas (default fabric — 10-year warranty)
- Sunbrella marine-grade acrylic for coastal applications
- Vinyl-coated polyester (heavy-duty / food-service)
- Shade-cloth / mesh fabric (open-weave, airflow + shade)
- Heavy-gauge aluminum tube framing
- Steel framing for commercial / heavy-duty applications
- Extruded aluminum systems (commercial walkway covers)
- Standing-seam, R-panel, corrugated metal panels
- Kynar 500 painted finishes (long-life metal coatings)
- Marine-grade stainless fasteners (coastal applications)
- Galvanized fasteners and hardware (inland)

## Common project types

- Restaurant patio awnings
- Retail and storefront awnings (with painted/embroidered signage)
- Hospitality (hotel) entry canopies
- Residential patio awnings and retractables
- Pool cabanas and outdoor-kitchen pavilions
- HOA-compatible residential awnings with drawings for review
- Estate-grade fabric awning systems for traditional homes
- Hurricane-rated coastal residential and commercial installations
- Historic-district storefront awnings (period-appropriate profiles)
- Commercial walkway covers (medical, institutional, office park)
- Drive-thru canopies (banking, fast-casual)
- Carports (residential and small commercial)
- Tensioned shade structures for schools, parks, and daycares

## Differentiators

- 40+ years of continuous Texas operation since 1984
- All work done in-house — no subcontractors
- Texas-based fabrication shop (Houston) — not a reseller or
  white-label installer
- Sunbrella Preferred Partner (authorized fabric distributor)
- In-house graphics department for printed/embroidered awning signage
- Hurricane-zone engineering experience (Texas Gulf Coast)
- Architectural coordination on estate residential projects
- Free on-site estimates statewide
